item.title: In Lebanon, more than 50 medics have been killed by Israel. Some say they're targeted
item.summary: Lebanon says at least 54 health workers are among more than 1,400 people killed by Israel during the current invasion. Human rights groups say first responders are being targeted — something Israel denies.

item.title: Trump unleashes curse-filled social media rant at Iran after U.S. rescues colonel
item.summary: In a profanity-laden post on Truth Social, President Trump lashed out at Iran and injected new volatility into the conflict, hours after U.S. forces carried out a high-risk rescue mission.

item.title: Hollywood studios reach a tentative agreement with writers union
item.summary: The Writers Guild of America went on strike for months in 2023 in a dispute with Hollywood studios. This year the union announced a new four-year contract after just a few weeks of negotiations.

item.title: NASA's Artemis II crew readies for Monday's lunar flyby. Here's what you need to know
item.summary: At its closest point, the crew of Artemis II will loop about 4,000 miles from the lunar surface late Monday. The astronauts will also venture farther into space than any previous human mission.

item.title: A music festival booked Kanye West, now known as Ye, and lost major sponsors
item.summary: The rapper Ye was announced as the headliner for the Wireless Festival in London. He's gained notoriety over the years for his antisemitic comments and activities glorifying Nazis.

item.title: These rock-climbing fish can shimmy up a 50-foot waterfall
item.summary: New research from the Democratic Republic of Congo offers a behavioral and anatomical portrait of a species that can achieve surprising athletic feats.

item.title: Sunday Puzzle: "To Be Announced"
item.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe plays the puzzle with WUNC listener Andrew Patton and Weekend Edition Puzzlemaster Will Shortz

item.title: UCLA storms past South Carolina to claim its 1st NCAA women's basketball title
item.summary: UCLA secured the first NCAA women's basketball national championship in school history — a goal that was set after losing in the first Final Four last season.

item.title: Questions to help you get 'financially naked' with your partner
item.summary: Having "brutally honest conversations" about money can bring couples closer together, says Vivian Tu, a financial educator. She shares questions to ask your partner at every relationship stage.

item.title: More teens are getting hooked on gambling. Parents say it often goes undetected
item.summary: The explosion of online gambling and sports betting, as well as the advertising behind it, is attracting a growing number of young people, most of them boys.
